deck.name: Image callouts remain editable
deck.description: Fractional text panels over the visible image frame.

slides.title: Read the picture and its labels together

image.alt: Four colored quadrants surround a central white inspection point.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: A timeless, clean, and versatile theme with balanced color contrasts and classic typography. Ideal for professional, readable presentations.

roboto.name: Roboto
roboto.description: Roboto is a sans serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Roboto for both headings and body text.

tenorite.name: Tenorite
tenorite.description: Tenorite is a sans serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Tenorite Display for headings with Tenorite for body text.

image.name: Image
image.summary: One picture, filling the slide or shown whole, under an optional title.
image.description: Let one picture carry the message. A photo close to the frame's shape fills it with a light crop (at most 7.5% off each edge); any other picture, a diagram or an SVG is shown whole at its own proportions (fit auto). Add a short title or caption to explain what the audience should notice. For a full-bleed crop of any picture, set the image block's fit to cover; to never crop, contain.

cool-horizon.name: Cool Horizon
cool-horizon.summary: Cool blue-green palette tuned for professional business decks.
cool-horizon.description: A balanced cool-toned scheme with deep navy, business blues, and teal accents. It works well across strategy, finance, and technical narratives.
